We have a departing executive who joined a direct competitor, and we believe confidential customer information may have been misused after the departure. A preliminary-injunction hearing could be requested within three weeks, so time is tight. I'd like each of you to report any material issues on your end before I record any authorization. Let's start with employment counsel -- do you have anything material to raise regarding the former executive, the employment relationship, or any restrictive covenants?
